summary: Opus review pass 2 (verification). Re-read every review-1 diff: no regressions or spec contradictions. Closed 6 of 7 low findings: cache keyed on yt-dlp-resolved id so short links share rows; Instagram auth markers narrowed; shutdown drains in-flight uploads; failed ffmpeg merge can no longer ship a silent video (leftover-name heuristic + ffprobe when present); combined parts respect MAX_FILE_MB; Dockerfile runs as non-root app user with /data chowned before VOLUME. Also removed dead module-level Router singletons left by pass 1 and restored the default-quality checkmark on the oversize retry card. Tests 129 → 157, ruff/format/mypy --strict clean on a fresh clone. Offline-verifiable acceptance (1, 9, 10, 12, 13, 14) re-confirmed. Not verifiable locally: 2–8, 11 (BOT_TOKEN), 15 (Docker), real ffmpeg paths.

findings.title: Acceptance items 2-8, 11 and 15 remain unverified locally
findings.details: Need live BOT_TOKEN, Docker and ffmpeg. Items 4, 6, 7, 8, 11 touch changed code paths.

findings.title: Non-root Dockerfile change not run against a Docker daemon
findings.details: Ordering pinned by a test; a pre-existing root-owned bot-data volume would break writes (documented in README). Verify with docker compose up on a clean volume.

findings.title: Silent-video detection is best effort without ffprobe
findings.details: Probe failure never rejects a download by design; filename heuristic covers the main case.

findings.title: FileTooLargeError raised inside the yt-dlp hook may be re-wrapped as DownloadError
findings.details: Limit is enforced either way; only the user-facing wording could degrade to the generic error.

findings.title: media_cache rows written before the key change are orphaned; table has no TTL
findings.details: Old URL-keyed rows stay; no migration added.

findings.title: Peak temp usage during a merge is still ~2x the final file
findings.details: ffmpeg writes the merged output while both parts are on disk.

findings.title: TikTok no-watermark selection can only be proven with a live link

fixed: file_id cache keyed on extractor-resolved id/webpage_url (short links share a row with the canonical URL)
Instagram auth markers narrowed to real login-wall/rate-limit phrases
Graceful shutdown waits for in-flight uploads as well as downloads
Failed ffmpeg merge cannot send a silent video (unmerged leftovers rejected, ffprobe audio check when available)
Dockerfile runs as unprivileged user app; /data chowned before VOLUME; healthcheck unchanged
Oversize retry card keeps the configured default quality marked
